purpose: Teach: 国内外/使い分け/要員/分業/リモート/仕事場/スペック/スクロール

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業時、国内外、両方を、視野に入れていた、私も。
lines.en: When we were founding, I had my sights set on both domestic and overseas markets too.
lines.style: Measured, reflective. Slight pause before the opening—drawing on memory. Warm but not sentimental. The weight of years in the phrasing, not the pace.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。社員、TPOに応じた使い分け、徹底しております。
lines.en: Yes. The staff practice situational awareness—adapting communication to context. We've made it thorough.
lines.style: Respectful formality with quiet pride underneath. Clipped but not rushed. Each phrase lands with care. The tone of someone reporting on something he genuinely believes in.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業時、たった三人の要員から、始まったな、覚えてる?
lines.en: We started with just three people, you remember? That's how it began.
lines.style: Nostalgic, almost gentle. Slight smile in the voice—not sad, but touched by the memory. Pace slows on the names of numbers. Trailing question carries no doubt, just invitation to shared recollection.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。創業の精神、分業を超えた、家族的な絆、引き継いでいます。
lines.en: Yes. I've inherited the founding spirit—that sense of family that goes beyond job titles and divisions.
lines.style: Sincere, steady. Slight emphasis on 'inherited' like it's both honour and responsibility. Not performative, just honest. The voice of someone who means what he says about culture.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 時代が変わっても、リモートばかりでは、社風、失われるぞ。
lines.en: But even as the times change, if we rely only on remote work, we'll lose the company's character.
lines.style: Direct, urgent but not panicked. Opens with quiet firmness. Slight lean forward in the delivery. The voice of an elder offering hard-won wisdom. Trails off slightly—not a question, an observation meant to land.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。創業者の仕事場、社史館で、再現しました。
lines.en: Yes. We've recreated the founder's original workspace in our company museum.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact pride. Clear delivery, no embellishment. Each word settled and sure. The tone of someone showing, not telling, what was done. Understated but present.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 品質のスペック、創業時と、同じこだわりで、追求しろ。
lines.en: Don't compromise on quality specs. Pursue the same standards we held from the beginning—that same dedication.
lines.style: Commanding but not cold. Sharp opening on 'don't'. Slow, deliberate pacing. Each phrase carries weight. The voice of someone who knows what matters and expects it to be remembered.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。社内資料、ペーパーレスでも、スクロール、しやすく、整備しています。
lines.en: Yes. Our internal documents are paperless, but I've made sure everything scrolls easily and stays organized.
lines.style: Practical, almost matter-of-fact. Clean delivery—the voice of someone solving problems quietly. No flourish. Finishes with understated competence. A wise close: simple, thorough, done.
